slides.title: Failure costs more than fatigue.
slides.body: Go to failure on set one and you need 40 seconds back. A planned break needs five.

slides.title: Break early. Break short.
slides.body: 30 wall balls? Try 12, 10, 8 with three breaths between. Decide before the clock starts.

slides.title: Count breaths, not seconds.
slides.body: Three breaths, then pick it up. If you are checking the clock, the rest is too long.

slides.title: Grip goes first.
slides.body: Pull-ups and toes-to-bar fall apart fastest. Break while your sets are still big.

slides.title: Last round, go unbroken.
slides.body: Planned breaks early buy you a fast finish. That is where the time comes back.
